Question Choices: Fill: A line that divides a shape into two matching halves is called a line of ________. (symmetry or rotation)
Hints: This word means that both sides look the same when you fold along the line.

Question Choices: Select. Which letter has a vertical line of symmetry?:L O P B
Hints: Imagine drawing a straight line down the middle of the letter. Which letter can be folded left to right so both halves match?

Question Choices: Select. Which shape has MORE than one line of symmetry?:A B C D
Hints: Think about which shape can be folded in more than one different way so that the two halves line up exactly each time

Question Choices: Select the shape that has exactly two lines of symmetry -one vertical and one horizontal. When you fold it along either line, both halves match.:Rectangle Circle Right-triangle Pentagon
Fill: A regular hexagon (all sides and angles equal) has ________ lines of symmetry.
Hints: Imagine folding the hexagon so that one vertex lands on another. How many different folds work?

Question Choices: Select the capital letter that has exactly two lines of symmetry- one vertical and one horizontal.:H A P T
Hints: Think of letters that look the same in a mirror left-right and also top-bottom.

Question Choices: Select. A shape has no lines of symmetry. Which of these could it be?:A B C D
Hints: In this triangle, all three sides and angles are different. No fold gives two matching halves.

Question Choices: Select. A shape has exactly one vertical line of symmetry but no horizontal line of symmetry.:A B C D
Hints: Try folding each shape on a line straight up and down. Only one shape will match on that fold, and it will NOT match if you fold it across (left to right)

Question Choices: Fill: This shape has exactly  5 lines of symmetry. It is a polygon, and all its sides and angles are equal. This shape must be a  ________. (triangle or square or pentagon or hexagon)
Hints: Regular polygons have as many lines of symmetry as they have sides. Think about how many sides a triangle, square, pentagon, and hexagon each has.

Question Choices: True or False: Every line that passes through the center of a circle is a line of symmetry.
Hints: If you fold a circle along any diameter, do the halves match?
